findings.title: test_run_enters_on_start_entryStepId test lives in FunnelServiceTriggerTypeTest, not FunnelExecutionEngineIT as the TDD Anchor prescribes
findings.description: The task's TDD Anchor specifies 'FunnelExecutionEngineIT::test_run_enters_on_start_entryStepId'. The implemented test is in FunnelServiceTriggerTypeTest (a service-level IT without the engine sweep). The test verifies currentStepId on the created execution document — it does NOT verify that the engine actually executes the correct step (no sweep, no sentCount assertion). This is not a security vulnerability but is noted because the spec's test placement exists to ensure full-path engine coverage, which is missing.
findings.impact: No exploitation surface. The behaviour is correctly implemented and a different test validates fire()-level entry. The gap is audit trail completeness rather than security.
findings.recommendation: Add a companion test in FunnelExecutionEngineIT that seeds an on_start funnel with entryStepId != array[0], calls testRun, then sweeps and asserts the engine executed the entry step (not array[0]) — mirroring the on_start_enters_entryStepId_regardless_of_order shape.

owasp_coverage.A01_broken_access_control: PASS — requireFunnel(ownerId, projectId, funnelId) enforces ownership before applyTriggers, testRun, and all mutation paths. The funnel-scoped stepIds set is derived from the SAME funnel's persisted steps, making cross-funnel entryStepId injection structurally impossible at the validation layer.
owasp_coverage.A02_cryptographic_failures: PASS — no new cryptographic surface introduced.
owasp_coverage.A03_injection: PASS — entryStepId is stored as a plain string and consumed only as a lookup key in stepIds.contains (a Java HashSet) and in MongoDB field value writes via Spring Data (parameterized). No dynamic query construction, no eval, no command interpolation.
owasp_coverage.A04_insecure_design: PASS — requireOnStartEntryStep is a dedicated private static helper (not inlined); the null-tolerant path is explicit and returns null rather than accepting arbitrary strings; cross-funnel ids are rejected because stepIds is built from THIS funnel's toSteps() output. fire() and testRun read entryStepId from a previously-validated Trigger document (not from the request body at execution time). resolveStartCursor provides a defence-in-depth fallback to step 0 for null/dangling ids.
owasp_coverage.A06_vulnerable_components: PASS — no new dependencies introduced in this commit.
owasp_coverage.A07_auth_failures: PASS — no new auth surface. fire() is an internal service method invoked by the webhook worker, not a public HTTP endpoint.
owasp_coverage.A08_software_data_integrity: PASS — no deserialization of untrusted input in the changed code. Snapshot deep-copy via FunnelStep.copyOf is unchanged.
owasp_coverage.A09_security_logging: PASS — fire() and testRun use existing greppable log constants; the entryStepId value is not echoed in log messages (PII-safe, id/code-only convention upheld).
owasp_coverage.A10_ssrf: PASS — no user-supplied URL is passed to any HTTP client in the changed paths.
owasp_coverage.hardcoded_secrets: PASS — no credentials, tokens, or secrets found in the diff.

key_security_checks.on_start_entryStepId_validation: PASS — requireOnStartEntryStep(entryStepId, stepIds): null → accepted (returns null); non-null not in stepIds → 422 CODE_INVALID_ENTRY_STEP; non-null in stepIds → accepted. stepIds is built from stepIdsOf(steps) where steps is THIS funnel's validated toSteps() output. Cross-funnel or arbitrary ids are structurally rejected.
key_security_checks.non_event_non_on_start_types_still_rejec: PASS — TRIGGER_KEYWORD, TRIGGER_TAG_ADDED, TRIGGER_CUSTOM_FIELD_SET cases all call requireNoEntryStep(dto.entryStepId()) unchanged (L754, L759, L764).
key_security_checks.fire_execution_entry_point: PASS — onStartEntryStepId(funnel) scans the funnel document's own triggers[] list (read from DB, not from the HTTP request body). A subscriber cannot influence entryStepId at fire() time; it is fixed at the funnel's last-saved value, which was validated by applyTriggers.
key_security_checks.testRun_execution_entry_point: PASS — same pattern as fire(): onStartEntryStepId(funnel) reads from the requireFunnel()-loaded document after ownership check.
key_security_checks.cross_funnel_entry: PASS — insertExecutionAt passes startStepId to resolveStartCursor which matches against the funnel's own deep-copied stepsSnapshot. Even if a stale/cross-funnel id somehow reached resolveStartCursor, the linear scan would miss it and fall back to step 0 — no arbitrary step entry.
key_security_checks.loop_backstop: PASS — advanceToNext rewrite does not remove the maxStepsPerTick budget guard in the drive loop.

summary: No critical or major security findings. The implementation correctly scopes on_start entryStepId validation to THIS funnel's step set, rejects cross-funnel and arbitrary ids with 422, accepts null (broken-edge state), and keeps all non-event/non-on_start types rejecting any entryStepId. The fire() and testRun execution entry points read entryStepId from a previously-validated Trigger document rather than from the request body, eliminating runtime injection of an arbitrary step. One minor finding: the test_run_enters_on_start_entryStepId test was placed in FunnelServiceTriggerTypeTest rather than FunnelExecutionEngineIT (as the TDD Anchor specifies), so engine-sweep coverage for testRun's entry path is absent — not a security issue.
